sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.4.0
- The club shipment editing screen has a fresh full-screen design that's easier to use, especially on phones.
- Editing an upcoming shipment is smoother: changing one wine's quantity no longer makes every row spin.
- You'll see a shipment's minimum bottle count right from the start, not just when you drop below it.
- Choosing your address and payment card now works the same way it does at checkout, with a cleaner card picker.
